title: Row space and computations with subspaces
objectives: Prove that row operations preserve the row space
Obtain a basis, coordinates and equations of a subspace from its echelon form
Describe every invertible matrix that reduces a given matrix
Solve membership, null space, solvability and intersection problems
prerequisites: Chapters 2 and 4: echelon forms, bases, dimension and coordinates.
source_scope: The captions of Lectures 9 and 10 were read in full; the 5 by 5 running matrix and the small example of Section 3 are the matrices read out in those captions, and the extra theorems and exercises are original.
